data.text:
BLOCKED (2026-10-15) — upstream fix required; both paths exhausted:

1) UPGRADE: latest provider-proxmox-bpg v1.21.0 still builds on upjet v2.2.0 — same async-callback self-conflict; no knobs changed. Not a fix vehicle.

2) UNPAUSE REPRODUCED (talos-pc01 MR): ~3800 MR writes in ~5.5 min (~590 RV bumps/min ≈ 10 RV bumps/s; 6× the incident's per-VM rate), then frozen at rv=156102356 after auto-brake re-applied crossplane.io/paused (Synced reason=ReconcilePaused). cb/min=0 throughout — conflicts are silent writes, no callback-failed log lines. VM Ready=True, provider-proxmox-bpg 1/1, provider healthy. Unpause without fix = guaranteed CPU storm recurrence (incident: kube-apiserver ~3 cores, macintel01 100% CPU).

CONCLUSION: keep all three EnvironmentVM MRs paused (commit 4df62139 annotations). Unpause condition = upstream provider release with async-callback conflict fixed (or upjet bump). Unpause procedure: revert annotation blocks in k8s/charts/crossplane-proxmox/templates/{workstation,windows,talos-pc01}.yaml.

UPGRADED 2026-10-16: provider-proxmox-bpg v1.15.0 -> v1.21.0 (736d1f0f chain: d1bd45b1 values+templates, 736d1f0f ignoreDifferences for runtimeConfigRef defaulting). Result: new ProviderRevision provider-proxmox-bpg-4ce19882438b Active, pull+activation clean, controller 1/1 Running 0 restarts, 0 EnvironmentVM log lines. 60s watch: all 3 VM RVs frozen (156102356/155803895/155803896), apiserver drifting down (3148m->2733m). CONFIRMED: v1.21.0 does not change the hot-loop (upjet v2.2.0 identical) — VMs stay paused via 4df62139 annotations; unpause still gated on an upstream release past the async-callback status-write conflict.

Unpause retest 2026-11-10 (provider v1.21.0 -> v1.24.0, d1bd45b1's gate satisfied: upstream shipped v1.22-v1.24 since the 2026-10-15 retest):

- 30-min soak of the `workstation` EnvironmentVM (stopped VM, live-annotation unpause): NO storm. 12 RV writes/30min (~0.4/min) decaying to reconcile cadence, vs ~90/min in the Oct-15 storm. Both paused controls (talos-pc01, windows) wrote ZERO — baseline flat.
- Provider runtime healthy throughout (0 restarts; one replacement pod caused by an unrelated dell01 NotReady flap at 14:53, not provider behavior).
- windows + workstation unpaused via git (d07e90c2 + 277a791b: chart templates + private overlay). talos-pc01 STAYS PAUSED: overlay said started:true but VM 100 is off (host down ~2026-11-04) — unpausing would power the sole-ish node on. Overlay now records all 3 VMs stopped; when the host returns, flip talosPc01.started (or workstation GPU-owner) in the overlay and unpause its template.
- Incidental fixes en route: stale GPU-guard render in crossplane-proxmox app (overlay claimed talos-pc01 + workstation both started -> ComparisonError since values drifted), provider runtime recovery on dell01, wedged cilium agent (23 restarts) + stale agent-not-ready taint cleared.

Remaining for full close: verify windows/workstation XR annotations cleared after the ArgoCD sync lands, and confirm no churn regression on the now-live XRs. talos-pc01 unpause is gated on a deliberate power-on decision, not on upstream.

CORRECTION to my 2026-11-10 15:31 comment: the storm DID reproduce on v1.24.0.

The '30-min soak, no repro' verdict was a units/counting error. RV-bump distinct-value counting under-measured; delta-based rate says:

- Soak (1 live XR, workstation): ~11 RV writes/s sustained (not 12/30min).
- Ambient with 2 live XRs (windows+workstation unpaused): ~18-19 writes/s per XR, FLAT rate (no runaway growth) — but faster than the Oct-15 record of '1.5/s across 3 VMs'.
- macintel01 climbed to ~94% CPU within minutes of the 2-XR unpause.

Repaused windows+workstation the same day (live patch + git 7c609b24). All 3 XRs paused again; v1.22-v1.24.0 releases (bpg/terraform bumps only) do NOT fix it. Root stays upjet async-callback status writes (upjet #768) — fix vehicle is an UPJET bump in valkiriaaquatica/provider-proxmox-bpg, which is still on v2.2.0; its tracker is renovate-only (no human issue filed).

Also fixed 2026-11-10 while testing: dell01 was OOM-thrashing from ~878 leaked containerd-shims (5.77 GB RSS rollup) on a 7.5 GB node — it OOM-killed besteffort pods (metallb-frr crashloop since Nov 7, cilium 23 restarts), starved the kubelet into NotReady flaps, and evicted the amd64-pinned provider pods. Force-rebooted; 878→11 shims, available memory 118 MB→3.8 GB. The 'provider runtime was down' observation earlier today was that eviction wave, not a package problem.

Remaining: file the upjet-bump request upstream (needs a human-maintained issue; tracker is renovate-only), then wait for an upjet > v2.2.0 release in the fork. talos-pc01 unpause additionally gated on a deliberate pc01 power-on.
